title: Signalbridge Quarterly Handoff
summary: Monthly company all-hands focused on operational readiness for Q4 close, people velocity, risk scenarios for the upcoming product rollout, and a short Q&A. Major notes: shipping M1 telemetry, hiring ramp delayed by two weeks, new SOC 2 audit kickoff, and tightened budget guardrails for non-headcount spend.
action_items: Maya Chen | Share M1 telemetry dashboard link with execs by 2025-11-14
Diego Ramos | Run staging perf run with 8k token tails and share results by 2025-11-20
Lena Ortiz | Publish revised hiring timeline and offer pipeline notes by 2025-11-18
Priya Nair | Finalize canary rollout plan w/rollback triggers by 2025-11-16
next_steps: Deck + recording to be uploaded to #all-hands channel
Teams to read SOC 2 prep checklist and nominate owners for controls
Schedule cross-functional tabletop exercise week of 2025-11-24
transcript:
Meeting Header:
Date: 2025-11-13
Start: 11:00 PT
Duration: ~62 minutes
Attendees (recording): Maya Chen, Diego Ramos, Priya Nair, Omar Beltran, Lena Ortiz, Samir Gupta, Tori Webb + many staff (zoom list truncated)

Summary (auto): Quick operational pulse, product telemetry, hiring update, SOC 2 kickoff, open Q&A.

[00:00] Maya Chen: ok hey everyone welcome to the Signalbridge quarterly handoff nice to see lots of faces, we're on the record. quick housekeeping: recording is on, q's in chat, please be concise.

[00:22] Omar Beltran: thanks Maya. I'll kick off with a short infra pulse — overall uptime has been stable, we've had one minor incident last week related to autoscale lag on Dedicated. didn't breach SLO but it's a warning flag.

[01:05] Samir Gupta: to add real quick, the autoscale lag happened during a burst that exceeded our prediction windows; we've patched the scheduler but we'll need a longer test with longer tail tokens. diego will lead that.

[01:48] Diego Ramos: yeah i'll coordinate the staging perf run, aim to simulate 8k token sequences across mixed batch sizes. expected runtime next wednesday.

[02:15] Priya Nair: product update — M1 telemetry is now ingesting usage from ~40% of beta customers. early signals: latency variance is lower on the quantized path but quality regressions appear on some prompt families. we have a small eval job to triage.

[03:02] Lena Ortiz: people update — hiring slowed a bit because we pushed a second interview loop redesign. offers are still going out but the ramp slides by about two weeks for core infra hires. we're reallocating contract budget to cover critical gaps.

[03:45] Maya Chen: ok thanks. quick question on that — how much runway do we need with the contract spend?

[04:05] Lena Ortiz: probably another 6 weeks of runway for the most critical roles if we re-up contracts, which we recommend. we'll publish a detailed matrix.

[04:38] Priya Nair: on the rollout plan — we are planning a staggered canary starting next monday for the hosted catalog. canary 1 will be low-percent traffic on model-x-quantized, canary 2 will evaluate prefix caching improvements. rollback triggers are latency > 2x baseline or quality regression on the canary promptset.

[05:22] Omar Beltran: important to flag data residency concerns for EU customers; the private deployment path is ready but requires a slightly different key rotation flow. security team has the doc.

[05:58] Tori Webb: CS note — a couple of pilot customers asked for audit logs per tenant as a must-have for onboarding. that maps to SOC 2 control requests.

[06:30] Maya Chen: perfect segue — SOC 2 audit kickoff. who wants that? Priya?

[06:45] Priya Nair: security will lead with Lena and Samir providing controls owners. high level: evidence collection starts next week, control mappings are in the shared drive. we need nominations for each control owner by Friday.

[07:10] Lena Ortiz: will do — we've got a template, i'll drop it in the #security channel.

[07:32] Maya Chen: thanks. moving to operational scenarios — we ran three tabletop scenarios, quick readouts please.

[07:48] Samir Gupta: scenario A: region outage. we looked at routing with smart fallback to regional compatible model variants. found a gap where customer tokenization choices caused mismatches. fix: normalize tokenizers at routing boundary.

[08:30] Diego Ramos: scenario B: long-tail token storms; batching helps but KV cache invalidations amplify memory usage. mitigation: adaptive cache eviction and tighter batch limits per worker.

[09:05] Priya Nair: scenario C: canary quality regression; our plan is to halt, switch traffic to verified fallback model, notify customers via status page and run immediate eval on the failing promptset.

[09:40] Maya Chen: ok good. budget guardrails — short version?

[09:55] Lena Ortiz: headcount spend remains priority. non-headcount discretionary spend > $25k needs exec signoff through finance. travel budgets frozen for next quarter except customer-critical travel.

[10:18] Maya Chen: noted. quick shoutouts before Q&A?

[10:25] Omar Beltran: shoutout to infra on the autoscale hotfix — Diego and team moved fast.

[10:35] Samir Gupta: shoutout to product evals folks for catching the prompt family regressions — that saved a risky rollout.

[10:45] Q&A Section (moderated):

[10:52] Staff Question (via chat): Are we changing the dedicated pricing for next quarter?

[11:05] Priya Nair: no immediate pricing change. we're doing a cost analysis and will share recommendations; any changes need board-level approval.

[11:30] Staff Question (live): What's the plan for private on-prem latency guarantees?

[11:48] Omar Beltran: for private deployments we provide SLO guidance per hardware profile. actual SLA requires a deployment audit and network checklist; engineering will partner with solutions to set expectations per customer.

[12:15] Staff Crosstalk (muffled): (someone): any change to open-source model policy?

[12:35] Priya Nair: no policy change — we still curate open models. new requirement is to run the curated eval battery before model is served publicly.

[12:58] Maya Chen: back to SOC 2 — who is owner for change control?

[13:15] Samir Gupta: i'll take that for dev infra.

[13:30] Diego Ramos: one more ops note: the staging perf run will include a KV cache stress test and will be instrumented for mem and tail latency.

[14:00] Maya Chen: great. sprint planning ask: teams, please prioritize the canary rollback automation ticket — it's the single biggest risk mitigation.

[14:23] Priya Nair: agreed — engineering will prioritize it in the next sprint, Diego and Samir to own the implementation.

[14:50] Lena Ortiz: hiring — small change: we will centralize interview feedback to reduce loop time. helps with the two-week slide.

[15:07] Maya Chen: ok time check — we're at ~15 minutes, we have another 45. let's do a short deep-dive on telemetry since a lot of you pinged about it.

[15:25] Priya Nair: telemetry deep-dive: M1 telemetry captures token-level latency and model-path selection. we saw a 12% lower p95 on quantized routes, but a 4-7% lower completion quality for a subset of prompts. next step: run A/B with prefix cache enabled to see if quality delta narrows.

[16:10] Diego Ramos: questions on instrumentation — are we sampling or full stream? currently sampling with adaptive thresholds, but for the upcoming run we'll enable full traces for 1 hour to capture worst-case tails.

[16:40] Staff (someone): will that affect costs?

[16:50] Priya Nair: yes but it's limited and covered by temporary observability budget.

[17:12] Maya Chen: ops note — we need a concise status page message template for canary pauses. Samir, can you draft that?

[17:30] Samir Gupta: yep will draft and circulate.

[17:45] Q&A continued — question about audit logging per-tenant SLA.

[18:02] Tori Webb: CS will draft required fields for the audit log and share with engineering; aim to have a prototype by the end of month.

[18:28] Maya Chen: okay final section: cross-functional commitments. each group names one measurable ownerable deliverable for the next two weeks. go around quick.

[18:42] Priya Nair: product — finalize canary trigger list and publish to #release by 2025-11-14.

[19:01] Diego Ramos: infra — staging perf run and data dump by 2025-11-20.

[19:22] Lena Ortiz: people — hiring timeline and control owner nominations by 2025-11-18.

[19:40] Samir Gupta: eng — implement rollback automation prototype by 2025-11-16.

[20:00] Maya Chen: awesome. closing remarks: short and sweet — we're in a good place, lots of moving parts but clear owners. record will be up, please add any missing action items to the deck thread.

[20:20] Maya Chen: thank you all. adjourned.

Notes: transcript imperfect — speaker attributions sometimes generalized; some timestamps approximate. Links mentioned during the call: M1 telemetry dashboard (link redacted), SOC 2 prep checklist (drive://soc2-prep), canary trigger doc (drive://canary-triggers).
